item.title: Commission sets date to fill vacancy after Edmund Ford resigns
item.description: MEMPHIS, Tenn. -- The Shelby County Commission passed a resolution Monday night recognizing the resignation of Edmund Ford Jr. and declaring a vacancy in the Office of Shelby County Commissioner for Commission District 9. Commissioners also set dates to fill the seat pursuant to the Shelby County Charter. Friday, February 20, is the application deadline. [...]
